# FirstReply

> FirstReply is lead follow-up software for real estate agents. Every new lead gets an instant, automatic email reply, and follow-up emails go out at 3 and 10 days, so slow response never costs the agent a lead. $129 per month per agent.

## How it works
- An agent signs up and receives a personal lead-capture link to share on a website, bio link or ad.
- When someone submits the form, FirstReply emails that lead an instant reply and emails the agent the lead's details.
- If the lead goes quiet, FirstReply sends automatic follow-up emails at 3 days and 10 days.
- The agent dashboard lists every lead and lets the agent mark it Contacted, Won or Lost.

## Pricing
- $129 per month per agent.
